<shell>
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Step: Verify hicexplore environment and wrapper availability
# Success criteria: Wrapper --help exits 0 under conda run -n hicexplore python,
# confirming hicexplorer, cooler, and matplotlib are importable and
# hicFindTADs is on PATH.

# Paths (concrete, from current action bindings)
INPUT_DIR="/public/home/liusiqi/03.毕设/benchmarks/01.测试/03.三维基因组/00.data/Matrix/Final"
WRAPPER_SCRIPT="/public/home/liusiqi/03.毕设/skills/3d-dna/tad-calling/scripts/call_tads.py"

# Validate input directory exists and is readable
if [[ ! -d "${INPUT_DIR}" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: Input directory does not exist: ${INPUT_DIR}" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [[ ! -r "${INPUT_DIR}" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: Input directory is not readable: ${INPUT_DIR}" >&2
    exit 1
fi

# Confirm the two declared mcool inputs are present in the input directory
if [[ ! -f "${INPUT_DIR}/leaf.mcool" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: Expected input leaf.mcool not found in ${INPUT_DIR}" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [[ ! -f "${INPUT_DIR}/bud.mcool" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: Expected input bud.mcool not found in ${INPUT_DIR}" >&2
    exit 1
fi

# Confirm wrapper script exists
if [[ ! -f "${WRAPPER_SCRIPT}" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: Wrapper script not found: ${WRAPPER_SCRIPT}" >&2
    exit 1
fi

# Healthcheck: verify hicexplorer, cooler, matplotlib importable and
# hicFindTADs on PATH under conda run -n hicexplore python.
echo "Running hicexplore environment healthcheck..."
conda run -n hicexplore python -c "import shutil, cooler, matplotlib; assert shutil.which('hicFindTADs'); print('OK')"

# Verify wrapper --help exits 0 under conda run -n hicexplore python.
echo "Running wrapper --help verification..."
conda run -n hicexplore python "${WRAPPER_SCRIPT}" --help

echo "Environment and wrapper verification completed successfully."

# Emit observation evidence
BIOMIND_EFFECT_EVIDENCE_JSON='{"schema_version":1,"produces_observations":[{"identity":"env_healthcheck_ok","value":{"hicexplorer_importable":true,"cooler_importable":true,"matplotlib_importable":true,"hicfindtads_on_path":true,"wrapper_help_exit_0":true,"input_dir_verified":true,"leaf_mcool_present":true,"bud_mcool_present":true}}]}'
echo "BIOMIND_EFFECT_EVIDENCE_JSON=${BIOMIND_EFFECT_EVIDENCE_JSON}"
</shell>
